title: Tate's sealed archive at University of Minnesota

tellings.quote: Long story short, we flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting at the University of Minnesota in their archives

plain: A sealed collection of papers belonging to a man named John Torrance Tate, covering roughly 1948 to 1950, is said to sit in the University of Minnesota archives in Minneapolis. A researcher named Scott Ramsey says he and his team flew to Minneapolis and got a meeting with the archive to see those records, and he mentions the electronics company Texas Instruments alongside Tate. Ramsey treats the papers as possible evidence for the crash story he is researching.
